The '''''Corellia Star'' captain''' was the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Corellia Star]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was killed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces while trying to deliver information on the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE Phantom]] project to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Corellia Star'' captain only appeared in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''. He was portrayed in the game by [[Marc Bauman]] and is credited as "Cargo Captain."
